translations./pieces/0/description: A three-meter modular deck that requires full support at two compatible endpoints.
translations./pieces/1/description: A three-meter emergency grating deck with slightly higher drag and more wet-weather traction reserve.
translations./pieces/2/description: A four-and-a-half-meter deck that crosses wider gaps at the cost of inventory and approach grade.
translations./pieces/3/description: A rigid module between a foundation and deck support point; it is not a driveable surface.
